name: Pomo Doro
author: dandrok
description: Live pomodoro countdown in the bar, sharing one session with the pomo-doro terminal app

barWidget.description: Focus countdown with start, pause, skip and today's stats

schema.label: CLI command
schema.description: The pomo-doro binary. Must be on the shell's PATH.

schema.label: State file
schema.description: Override the session state file. Defaults to ~/.config/pomo-doro-nodejs/state.json.

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: Take no room in the bar unless a pomodoro is running.

schema.label: Show seconds
schema.description: Off shows whole minutes remaining, which is calmer to glance at.

schema.label: Notify on phase change
schema.description: Raise a shell notification when focus or a break ends. The CLI already sends its own - turn this on only after muting it in the app's Settings, or you get each transition twice.

schema.label: Focus minutes
schema.description: Used by the popup's Start button.

schema.label: Default tag
schema.description: Tag applied to sessions started from the bar. Empty reuses the last one.

schema.label: Terminal command
schema.description: How the popup opens the full terminal UI.
